schema:name: Zhang et al. (2022) Iron Meteorite LA-ICP-MS v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Zhang et al. 2022 (GCA 323) Iron meteorites Raster mapping + Spot (Ge) ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Florida State University (column M of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v2.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: Plasma Analytical Facility, Florida State University, Tallahassee FL, USA

schema:object: Iron meteorite metal (kamacite + taenite); pyroxene-bearing pallasite metal
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: Polished metal slabs and thin sections; no acid treatment described
ada:laserManufacturerModel: ESI New Wave UP193FX (193 nm Nd:YAG frequency-quintupled solid state)
ada:detectorConfiguration: Triple mode detection (pulse counting + analog + Faraday) at 65% duty cycle
ada:laserSpotGeometryDefault: Raster: 50 µm circular beam spot; Spot (Ge): 150 µm circular
ada:laserSpotPathAblationMode: Raster area (2D mapping) for most irons; Spot (stationary) for Ge analysis on 5 irons
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: Standards at start of session → raster unknowns → repeat → standards at end; separate session for Ge spot analyses
ada:internalStandardApproach: Standardization techniques followed those of Humayun (2012) [Section 2.2; specific IS approach not restated in this paper]
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Multi-point external calibration using series of iron meteorite reference materials (North Chile Filomena as primary standard for Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Ga/Ge/As/W/Au; Hoba for Ru/Rh/Pd/Re/Os/Ir/Pt; NIST SRM 1263a V-Cr steel for V/Cr/Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/As/Mo/W/Au)
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each raster analysis; mean background subtracted
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: North Chile Filomena (IIAB iron meteorite; Wasson et al. 1989) for Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Ga/Ge/As/W/Au; Hoba (IVB; Walker et al. 2008) for Ru/Rh/Pd/Re/Os/Ir/Pt; NIST SRM 1263a V-Cr steel (Campbell & Humayun 2005) for V/Cr/Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/As/Mo/W/Au

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coupling Description
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Quantitative analysis, mixed WDS/EDS element mapping, and characterization of mineral phases from NWA 1911 and Zinder [Section 2.5]

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
Drift Monitor Frequency
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Standards at start and end of session; external bracketing

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Standard deviation (SD) across individual integration cycles of raster scans; uncertainty propagation not formally described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Applied: triple mode detection at 65% duty cycle (pulse counting + analog + Faraday); specific cross-calibration not described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: External calibration with iron meteorite and NIST SRM 1263a V-Cr steel standards; no post-acquisition normalization described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Additional Notes
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Raster scans used for main element dataset (23 elements); separate spot analyses on 5 irons for more precise Ge abundances (150 µm spot, 50 Hz, 20 s); two different analysis modes represent distinct protocols but are reported in same paper

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.
